flow.input: native count status and bundle preview
flow.transformation: unchecked Bash wc/filter status produces empty count; Bash preview loses trailing LF; PowerShell preview omits writer newline/BOM

findings.impact: Failed/malformed Bash counts bypass --max-bytes and both twins undercount final emitted serialization bytes, allowing oversized bundles.
findings.resolution: Every Bash admission count now checks status and numeric shape; measurement streams actual final header/content bytes. PowerShell counts unchanged writer host newline and Desktop UTF8 preamble at all three measurement sites. Both twins reject cap-minus1 and accept exact actual file length for populated/empty inputs.
findings.reuse: Shared private checked-count mechanism; no new config or public API.
